title: Simplify WebView table controls
summary: Remove row-search, alternate density choices, and column filter-row UI from shared WebView tables.
reason: The operator only uses the default table presentation and does not need the extra density presets, row-search box, or per-column filter row controls shown in the GPU details table.
behavior_before: Enhanced WebView tables rendered a row-search box, a density selector with Compact, Default, and Comfortable choices, and a Column filters toggle that could reveal per-column filter input rows.
behavior_after: Enhanced WebView tables keep the default presentation without rendering row-search, alternate density choices, or column filter-row controls.
